verifiedProgress.fact: Dated public racing reports now explicitly confirm the first-shipment horses are in Australia / arrived in Melbourne; prior SCHEDULED_TO_TRAVEL status is superseded.

verifiedProgress.note: Public R&S race field verifies acceptance, barrier and race-day weight. No numeric R&S performance rating inferred from Neurals/enhanced-form columns.

verifiedProgress.scope: first acceptances / international shipment status recheck
verifiedProgress.fact: VRC confirms 71 remain after first acceptances, including 13 internationals. First shipment in Melbourne: Small Fry, Kizlyar, Omni Man, Starford, Wine Dark Sea, Enfjaar, Point Of Law. Second shipment in pre-export quarantine: Sons And Lovers, Trustyourinstinct, Defiantly, James J Braddock, Goodie Two Shoes, Stinger Glass, Hopewell Rock. Second declarations due 13 Oct 2026.

Melbourne Cup campaign is no longer active. Constitution Hill finished fourth in the Group 3 September Stakes at Kempton, missing the top-three qualifying performance; connections now target the Group 2 Gran Premio del Jockey Club at San Siro on 25 Oct 2026.
verifiedProgress.note: Preserve in fixed original 101-nominee universe; status update does not remove original nomination.

Published accepted field verifies barrier and race-day weight. Knight's Choice earlier intended-run evidence is quarantined because the horse is absent from the published field. No numeric R&S rating inferred.

verifiedProgress.fact: Racing Victoria imposed a 0.5kg Melbourne Cup penalty after the G3 Colin Stephen Quality win, raising the official Cup weight from 52.0kg to 52.5kg and improving the horse to 49th in the order of entry.

VRC continues to confirm the fixed original universe was 101 nominations (78 local, 23 international), official weights were allocated to all 101 on 17 Sep, and first acceptances reduced the active Cup pool to 71 on 29 Sep. The acquisition ledger remains fixed to the original 101 rather than deleting non-acceptors.

verifiedProgress.scope: second international shipment / scheduled arrival verification
verifiedProgress.fact: Fresh public reporting verifies Sons And Lovers, Trustyourinstinct, Defiantly, James J Braddock and Goodie Two Shoes are in mandatory two-week pre-export quarantine in Ireland; Hopewell Rock is also in quarantine. The European shipment is scheduled to arrive Melbourne on 13 Oct 2026. Stinger Glass is preparing to travel from Japan and is scheduled to arrive on 11 Oct 2026. Highwayman has been withdrawn from the Melbourne Cup campaign despite completing veterinary requirements and will remain in Europe.
verifiedProgress.note: Campaign/travel status only. Preserve Highwayman in the fixed original 101-nominee ledger; do not treat scheduled arrival as completed travel.
